description: This PHP source file defines a Symfony console command named EventDispatcherDebugCommand, which is used for debugging and displaying the event listeners registered in the event dispatcher within the OrangeHRM HRM system's development tools. It initializes the framework, retrieves event listeners, and outputs their details in a table format.

classes.name: EventDispatcherDebugCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command class for debugging event listeners in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command with SymfonyStyle IO object.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command to retrieve and display event listeners with their priority in a table format.
